# Outputs

<!-- Generated by scripts/skill_outputs.py from outputs.yaml: do not edit by hand. -->

## Required outputs

| Output | Form | Recipient | Complete when |
|---|---|---|---|
| sign-off-package | `assets/cybersec-signoff-package.md`, filled | IIAE or Plant IT, who submit it to Cyber Security | Case classified (machine connection or app deployment); Contents follow `references/package-contents.md` and come from existing outputs; Credentials, addresses, certificates and tokens are listed as existing, never pasted |
| routed-decision-request | A request on the row "Equipment integration go-ahead", using the decision request template of `dept-decision-rights` | `dept-decision-rights` | Opened; The sign-off is recorded as a dependency on the use case or machine record |
| wait-state-record | Section of the package | OD lead (escalation) | Submission date, follow-up owner and next check recorded; No go-live date promised |
| recorded-answer | Section of the package | `deploy-acceptance`, `mi-equipment`, `deploy-appstore` | Names who answered, date, scope, conditions and validity; Outcome is granted, granted with conditions (conditions become open items) or refused (barrier routed); Or the case is held with an owner and an escalation date |

## Checks

| Output | Check | Sign-off |
|---|---|---|
| sign-off-package | structure of `assets/cybersec-signoff-package.md` | IIAE or Plant IT |
| routed-decision-request | manual | OD lead |
| wait-state-record | manual | OD lead (escalation) |
| recorded-answer | manual | OD lead |

## Handoff

- **Receives from:** `deploy-migration`, `funnel-first-aid`, `catalog-guardrails`, `mi-equipment`, `deploy-appstore`, `deploy-acceptance`
- **Next:** dept-decision-rights, then deploy-acceptance and go-live once the sign-off is recorded.: `dept-decision-rights`, `deploy-acceptance`
- **Stops here when:** no named answer is on record
- **Stops here when:** A missing sign-off holds the case: no expedited path, no machine connected, no app deployed live on an unanswered request, and "implied", "verbal" or "covered" is not a sign-off
